title: Mürekkepbalığı Olmak İsteyen Martı
author: Öznur Karaeloğlu
description:
Heus is a seagull who is very curious about life underwater and dreams of exploring the seas just
like fish do. But doing so is so di&cult… Perhaps there is a fish in the sea who dreams of flying just
as Heus dreams of swimming freely, and Heus can help him fly. Why not? Adventurous Murmur
witnesses the friendship between a cu"lefish and a seagull and shows once again how valuable
cooperation can be.
english_title: The Seagull That Wanted To Be A Cuttlefish
